title: Alpha vs Omega
start: Talk to Rasial in the City of Um.

rewards.t: Access to the Rasial, the First Necromancer boss encounter

steps.t: Talk to Rasial, the First Necromancer on the bridge in the City of Um. [Chat: Accept]

sub.t: If Rasial, the First Necromancer isn't there, home teleport to the City of Um or relog.

steps.t: Talk to Kharen in City of Um to travel to Rasial's Citadel. [Chat: 1 Yes.]

sub.t: You must talk to Kharen; using the right-click travel option will not start the fight.

steps.t: Defeat Hermod, the Spirit of War. Cannot be killed with deathtouched dart.
Defeat Rasial, the First Necromancer. Cannot be killed with deathtouched dart.
A cutscene ensues. Continue speaking with Rasial, the First Necromancer.
Return to Death in the City of Um to complete the quest.
p: Rasial, the First Necromancer uses his spirit wall attack
Rasial, the First Necromancer is finally defeated.
